## Sync must never green-lie: per-file generation failures are now first-class… — 2026-07-25 (parent 568772984973)

`SchedulerResult` gains an `errors` field (list of `(rel_path, message)` tuples) so per-file processing exceptions are no longer silently folded into `skipped_other`. `_RunState._collect` now appends to `errors` instead of incrementing `skipped_other`. Both `IncrementalResult` and `BootstrapResult` thread this field through from the scheduler.

On the CLI side, the new helper `_report_sync_errors` prints up to five per-file failures, appends a credentials hint when the message suggests a missing API key, and returns a boolean indicating whether any errors occurred. `_run_incremental_sync` and `_run_full_pass` call it and exit 1 on any failure; an all-failed incremental

- ~ trie/sync/scheduler:_RunState._collect — "Processes completed file sync future, updating _RunState results and checking budget/limit caps." → "Processes completed file sync future, updating `_RunState` results and checking budget/limit caps."
- ~ trie/sync/incremental:IncrementalResult — New file_errors field threaded from the scheduler.
